title: kinetixui.json
description: Project config read by the kinetixui CLI (`kinetixui init` writes it, `kinetixui add` reads it).

registry.description: Optional. Where the CLI fetches components from. Omitted by default, which means https://kinetixui.com/r. Set it to a mirror if your builds cannot depend on that origin; the --registry flag still wins when passed.

css.description: Path to the global stylesheet the token contract is written into.

srcDir.description: Prefix every resolved path with src/.
